channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steve Nash | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steve Nash from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Steve Nash
item.description:
Channing Frye says Steve Nash is a better overall player than Russell Westbrook:

“Russell Westbrook is the most,top two most athletic guard ever to play basketball though. But, Steve Nash is a 50-40-90 guy. Where Russell has just God-given ability and motor that no one’s ever seen ever before. So, Steve Nash is my guy. So, yes,Steve Nash is better than Russell Westbrook.”

Russell Westbrook on Steve Nash, Aug 8, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Donnie Nelson on Steve Nash, Tim Hardaway
item.description:
Now a player he thought compared to other unconventional all-time greats he had drafted -- Steve Nash and Tim Hardaway -- had somehow fallen to his team at No. 33.

“All I know is he had the same things that Hardaway and Nash had -- heart, brains and balls,”

Donnie Nelson on Steve Nash, Tim Hardaway, Jun 8, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Steve Nash
item.description:
SGA on his relationship with Steve Nash:

“Funny enough, Steve was the first person who told me I was going to make the NBA.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Steve Nash, May 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton
item.description:
When asked about the players who influenced his style, CJ McCollum rattled off a list of all-time greats.

“Besides my brother? I watched a lot of Allen Iverson. I watched a lot of Steve Nash. I watched a lot of Rip Hamilton. I watched young Gilbert [Arenas] and obviously Kobe and Mike,”

CJ McCollum on Allen Iverson, Steve Nash, Gilbert Arenas, Richard Hamilton, Mar 23, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Steve Nash
item.description:
Amare Stoudemire:

“A lot of people were saying, ‘Well, Stoudemire is only good because of Nash.’ And I’m like, ‘Well, that’s not true.’So, when I went to New York, I had to show the world, like, ‘This is my game.’ And because of that, a lot of my teammates jumped on that wave, and we started rolling. Then we made a trade and brought in Melo, and we kept it going. It was a whole thing.”

Amare Stoudemire on Steve Nash, Dec 18, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Steve Nash
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Chris Paul says there was nothing to see when Dillon Brooks was rolling around on the floor with Wemby:

“I'm just saying y'all done seen a lot worse. Steve Nash ran into the doggone scorer's table, right? They bleeding and all that stuff... Come on man. We are NBA players.”

Dillon Brooks on Steve Nash, Oct 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Steve Nash, Dirk Nowitzki
item.description:
“But it’s good, at the end of the day Dirk [Nowitzki] and Steve [Nash] know I wasn’t healthy enough to play. I wanted to be more with my kids and it was an easy decision. I miss games and locker rooms, but I don’t miss practices. Especially in Miami, where they were tough. But I wouldn’t change it, I’m satisfied with my career, Right now I’m happy, no pain anymore”

Goran Dragic on Steve Nash, Dirk Nowitzki, Aug 24, 2024. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Byron Scott on Steve Nash
item.description:
“[Steve Nash] never had any coaching experience and it didn't really work out well in Brooklyn for him,”

Byron Scott on Steve Nash, May 26, 2024. Source: TMZ.com.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Steve Nash, Stephon Marbury
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:SGA on Stephon Marbury calling him the best all-time player from Canada:

“I appreciate it but Steve (Nash) is still ahead of me. Imma try to catch him but he's still ahead of me.”

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Steve Nash, Stephon Marbury, Feb 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Steve Nash
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Steve Clifford on Nets/Nash divorce:

“There's always things you can do better as a coach, but the problem there was not coaching. Nor receptiveness to the way we did things. I totally disagree with any of that and sometimes it's just health.”

Steve Clifford on Steve Nash, Nov 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Steve Nash
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau on Steve Nash:

“He's a great guy. I think he's a heck of a coach. But it's the unfortunate part of this business... I have a lot of respect for him.”

Tom Thibodeau on Steve Nash, Nov 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Steve Nash
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Jason Kidd on Steve Nash:

“He’s one of the better coaches in this league. His IQ is off the charts.”

Jason Kidd on Steve Nash, Oct 27, 2022. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Kobe Bryant, Steve Nash
item.description:
Nowitzki instead opted to sign a four-year contract extension to remain in Dallas, though.

“I remember Kobe (Bryant) tried to get me to come to L.A. at some point,and (Steve Nash) was reaching out to me at some point,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Kobe Bryant, Steve Nash, Apr 7, 2022. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Nash, Charles Barkley, Reggie Miller
item.description:
“It’s the nature of the ball not bouncing your way here or there, injuries, breaks, stuff like that. But perennially, a guy like CP, you want him on your team no matter what. He’s made every team he has been on competitive and better than they would be otherwise. However you calculate that or quantify that, it’s winning. You want to have the championships. “But nobody questions his ability to impact the game and to win at the highest level. The championship will probably be nice for him, but that’s not going to define him. You got guys like Charles Barkley, Steve Nash, Reggie Miller, a who’s who of Hall of Famers who haven’t won a championship. You understand how hard it is.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Nash, Charles Barkley, Reggie Miller, Jan 10, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Devin Booker on Steve Nash, Mark Jackson
item.description:
Suns guard Devin Booker said of Paul's achievements.

“We go in the locker room like, 'Oh you passed Steve Nash, Mark Jackson. Game ball.' It's bigger than that, man. It really is. Obviously I know he was going to be close coming into today and he passed it by a lot. I'm just happy to be a part of it.”

Devin Booker on Steve Nash, Mark Jackson, Nov 3, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Devin Booker on Steve Nash, Mark Jackson
item.description:
“We keep acting like this is normal. When we go in the locker room afterward, 'Oh he passed Steve Nash, Mark Jackson. Game ball.' It's bigger than that, man. It really is.”

Devin Booker on Steve Nash, Mark Jackson, Nov 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: James Harden on Steve Nash
item.description:
Michael Scotto:James Harden on his impression of Steve Nash:

“How much of a genius he is as far as basketball. He’s elite. That’s obvious winning two MVPs. His IQ is above the charts and our communication is constant”

James Harden on Steve Nash, May 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Steve Nash
item.description:
Brian Lewis:#Heat coach Erik Spoelstra on the job Steve Nash has done with the #Nets:

“Yeah, I think all of the Hall of Fame qualities that Steve Nash developed over so many years as a player, I think those things very quickly translate to the head coaching position.”

Erik Spoelstra on Steve Nash, Apr 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Steve Nash
item.description:
“I tell Steve (Nash) all the time: I hate it when we lose, but I’m gonna go home and go to bed. You need to worry about this shit for tomorrow.”

Mike D'Antoni on Steve Nash, Apr 14, 2021. Source: TrueHoop.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Steve Nash
item.description:
Looking back, D’Antoni wishes there had been more math in Phoenix.

“I’ve told Steve (Nash) a thousand times—we didn’t go far enough with our approach because we didn’t have analytics,”

Mike D'Antoni on Steve Nash, Apr 14, 2021. Source: TrueHoop.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Steve Nash, Sean Marks
item.description:
Why did you choose Brooklyn over LA?Blake Griffin:

“They have a need for a 4-man. I’ve always had a lot of respect for Steve Nash and all of the guys they have. Sean Marks has done a great job there. It was a tough decision and I wanted to be on a team that was contending.”

Blake Griffin on Steve Nash, Sean Marks, Mar 8, 2021. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Steve Nash
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Popovich on his memories of coaching against Steve Nash as a player:

“He’s one of the all-time great competitors, but while competing also one of the great thinkers…And a class act.”

Gregg Popovich on Steve Nash, Mar 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Steve Nash
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Steve Kerr on similarity with Nash inheriting the #Nets:

“The challenge is similar in that if you've never coached you have a lot to learn & I definitely had plenty to learn that 1st year,just as Steve does this year... And Steve's team radically changed a month in.”

Steve Kerr on Steve Nash, Feb 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Steve Nash
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Steve Nash:

“I think he's going to be a fantastic coach. They couldn't have hired a better person for that job.”

Steve Kerr on Steve Nash, Dec 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Steve Nash
item.description:
Alex Schiffer:Irving on Nash:

“Steve's been amazing. He commands the respect. It's giving us a comfortable space to grow, to communicate. You have a two-time MVP coaching.”

Kyrie Irving on Steve Nash, Dec 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @Alex__Schiffer.

item.title: Landry Shamet on Steve Nash
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Landry Shamet on #Nets D being installed:

“Steve (Nash) made a really big emphasis on defense,a couple nuances and changes that I haven’t seen before that are exciting just because they are a little outside the box and are forward-thinking.”

Landry Shamet on Steve Nash, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Spencer Dinwiddie on Steve Nash
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Spencer Dinwiddie on whether he grew up a Steve Nash fan as a Lakers fan:

“There’s a difference between respect and like, because he used to battle the Lakers so I hated him.”

Spencer Dinwiddie on Steve Nash, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Jarrett Allen on Steve Nash
item.description:
“And then Steve Nash, nobody was really expecting that. I didn’t know what was going on; it was all a whirlwind. But overall I’m really happy.”

Jarrett Allen on Steve Nash, Nov 17, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Steve Nash
item.description:
“That’s going to be a lot of fun [for Nash] and it’s a lot of challenges, but I think he’s up for it,”

Dirk Nowitzki on Steve Nash, Oct 13, 2020. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Spencer Dinwiddie, Taurean Prince, Steve Nash
item.description:
Durant on Nash's presence:

“I think having Steve there and collaborating with our floor general every day is only gonna yield good results for our scorers like myself and Taurean, Caris and Spencer. Them having that relationship I think is gonna be key for us going forward.”

Kevin Durant on Spencer Dinwiddie, Taurean Prince, Steve Nash, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Twitter.
